title: Lazy context-block mechanism
description:
As a bot author, I want named context blocks (template plus data provider) rendered at prompt assembly for each model call, so that dynamic context reaches the model without tools.

Feature: Context blocks
  Scenario: A block renders at model-call time
    Given a block with a template and a provider
    When the prompt is assembled
    Then the block renders from current data
    And an empty provider omits the block
right_now_summary: The feature will render named context blocks with fresh data at each model call.
